backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing a skill gap analyzer with resume management, job role matching, access control mixins, and blob storage for resume files; includes data types for resumes, skills, education, work experience, and comparison metrics.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the removal of Caffeine.ai branding from frontend components, listing affected files, components, and test IDs with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend TypeScript/React components including routing, authentication, admin panels, analysis workflows, charts, and UI components for the skill gap analyzer application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI elements like backgrounds, borders, charts, and sidebar components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with viewport meta tags and a root div for mounting the app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, analysis flow, dashboard, admin panel, resume upload/results, and comprehensive result pages; includes authentication state management, profile setup modal, and theme provider.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Component displaying an access denied message with shield icon and return-to-home button for unauthorized users attempting to access admin areas.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: Higher-order component that checks admin permissions via useIsCallerAdmin hook and renders children only for authorized admins, otherwise shows AccessDeniedScreen.
frontend/src/components/CompareResumesVi: Component for side-by-side resume comparison displaying metrics like overall score, experience level, education count, skills, and certifications in a grid layout with cards.
frontend/src/components/ConfirmDeleteDia: AlertDialog component for confirming resume deletion with cancel and confirm actions, displaying the resume name and handling loading states.
frontend/src/components/DownloadReportBu: Button component that generates and downloads a personalized PDF analysis report using the pdfGenerator service, with loading states and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/GapAnalysisResul: Displays skill gap analysis results in a two-column card layout, showing matching skills (with green styling) and missing/insufficient proficiency skills (with red/amber styling), categorized by technical and soft skills with color-coded proficiency badges.
frontend/src/components/JobRoleForm.tsx: Form component for creating or editing job roles with title, description, and dynamic skill list management. Handles validation, submission via React Query mutations, and displays toast notifications for success/error states.
frontend/src/components/JobRoleMatchResu: Displays a list of job role match results sorted by compatibility percentage, showing match scores, progress bars, skill counts, and a button to view detailed gap analysis for each role.
Radio group component that fetches and displays available job roles with their required skills as selectable cards, showing loading skeletons and empty states, with color-coded proficiency badges for skills.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main application layout with sticky header navigation, authentication-aware menu items (Analyze, Admin, Resume Upload), mobile responsive menu, and integration with Internet Identity login state.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component that handles Internet Identity login/logout with loading states, clears query cache on logout, and displays appropriate icons and text based on authentication status.
frontend/src/components/ProficiencyGapCh: Bar chart visualization component using Recharts that displays the distribution of matching vs. missing skills across three proficiency levels (Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced).
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for initial user profile setup with form fields for name (required), email, education, and experience. Submits profile data via useSaveCallerUserProfile hook and prevents closing until completed.
frontend/src/components/RecommendationsD: Displays personalized learning recommendations for skill gaps, showing recommended courses with provider links and practice projects for each missing skill. Shows success message if no gaps exist.
frontend/src/components/ResumeList.tsx: Lists uploaded resumes with metadata (skills, experience, education counts) and timestamps. Supports resume selection and deletion with confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/components/ResumeUpload.tsx: Handles PDF resume upload with validation (type, size), parses content using NLP service, extracts skills, validates required sections (experience, skills, education), and converts to backend format before uploading.
frontend/src/components/ScoreBreakdown.t: Displays detailed resume score breakdown with overall score visualization, category scores (completeness, content quality) with progress bars, and color-coded feedback items with icons.
frontend/src/components/SkillCategoryCha: Bar chart component using Recharts to visualize matching vs missing skills grouped by category (Technical and Soft Skills).
Pie chart component using Recharts to show the proportion of matching skills versus missing skills with percentage labels.
frontend/src/components/SkillMatchGapDis: React component that displays a detailed skill gap analysis comparing user skills against job role requirements, categorizing skills as matching, missing, or insufficient proficiency with visual badges and icons.
React component that renders categorized skill badges (technical, soft, domain) with color-coded proficiency levels (beginner, intermediate, advanced) and category icons.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that manages the backend actor instance with authentication, automatically recreating the actor when identity changes and invalidating dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Custom React hook and provider for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for backend data operations including user profiles, job roles, resumes, and admin functions with automatic cache invalidation and toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useResumeAnalysis.ts: Custom mutation hook that orchestrates resume analysis by parsing files with AI, saving extracted data to backend, and uploading file blobs with progress tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm, education-focused color palette for light and dark modes including primary coral, secondary teal, and chart colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication context.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin panel page for managing job roles with CRUD operations, displaying job roles in cards with their required skills, proficiency levels, and delete/edit actions protected by AdminGuard.
frontend/src/pages/AnalysisDashboard.tsx: Dashboard page that displays comprehensive skill analysis results including match percentages, skill gaps, recommendations, and various charts after validating resume data from navigation state.
frontend/src/pages/AnalysisFlow.tsx: Main analysis workflow page with tabs for uploading or selecting resumes, calculating job role matches, and navigating to detailed analysis with authentication guard.
frontend/src/pages/ComprehensiveResultPa: Detailed resume result page showing resume score breakdown, skill categorization, gap analysis, recommendations, with edit mode and resume comparison features.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero section and feature cards explaining the four-step process: upload resume, select job role, get analysis, and receive recommendations.
frontend/src/pages/ResumeResultsPage.tsx: Displays comprehensive resume analysis results including resume score, contact info, work experience, education, skills (categorized), and certifications. Uses AdminGuard for access control and fetches data via useGetResumeData hook.
frontend/src/pages/ResumeUploadPage.tsx: Provides drag-and-drop and file selection UI for uploading resumes (PDF, JPG, PNG up to 10MB). Uses useResumeAnalysis hook to process files and navigates to results page upon successful analysis.
frontend/src/services/aiResumeParser.ts: Converts uploaded resume files to bytes and calls extractComprehensiveResumeData from nlpService to parse resume data including contact info, skills, work experience, education, and certifications.
frontend/src/services/gapAnalysis.ts: Compares extracted resume skills against job role requirements to identify missing skills, matching skills, and skills with insufficient proficiency levels. Returns gap analysis with resume context including experience, education, and certifications.
frontend/src/services/nlpService.ts: Extracts structured data from resume PDFs including text extraction, contact info parsing (email, phone, LinkedIn, location), professional summary extraction, and work experience/education parsing. Provides comprehensive resume data structure.
frontend/src/services/pdfGenerator.ts: Generates downloadable text-based skill gap analysis reports including job role match percentage, matching/missing skills, personalized recommendations with courses and projects, and candidate profile with experience and education details.
frontend/src/services/recommendationEngi: Generates personalized course and project recommendations based on skill gaps, using hardcoded databases of courses (Udemy, Coursera, etc.) and project ideas mapped to specific skills like JavaScript, Python, React, SQL, and more.
frontend/src/services/resumeScoring.ts: Calculates a comprehensive resume score (0-100) across four dimensions: completeness, content quality, formatting, and skill relevance, providing detailed feedback for each criterion to help users improve their resumes.
frontend/src/services/skillExtraction.ts: Extracts and categorizes skills from parsed resume data into technical, soft, and domain categories, and calculates experience level and total years of experience from work history duration.
frontend/src/services/skillMatching.ts: Implements skill matching algorithms that compare resume skills against job role requirements, considering both skill names and proficiency levels to calculate match percentages and identify matching/missing skills.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support for maintaining state across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, extended typography, container queries, animations (accordion), and custom font families (Inter, Poppins) for the application's design system.
project_state.json: Project state file tracking a feature request (AR-2) to remove caffeine.ai watermark from the application, with one existing completed feature (REQ-1) that already removed Caffeine.ai branding. The project is at version 5 with instant clarification mode enabled.
